data.name: Echoes of Creation: Origin
data.detailed_description:
Echoes of Creation

A solo-developed 3D MMO RPG.

Echoes of Creation began in March 2026 as a one-person project — designed and developed by a solo developer. It's a passion project about grinding for loot, building the character you want, and uncovering the story of the Creator who shaped the world.

The Story

The world was shaped by a mysterious figure known only as the Creator, who brought forth two mythical beings — the Light and the Dark. After the Light sacrificed herself to save the world, the Dark seized the chance to seal her away, and darkness has crept across the land ever since. Guided by Elder Maren of Eloria Village, you set out zone by zone to free the sealed Light and confront The Forgotten One.

Features

Real-Time Action Combat

  • Fast, third-person open world 3D combat with skills, critical hits, and status effects (stun, poison, bleed, slow)

  • Four weapon types — sword, dagger, bow, and staff — each with its own feel

Four Classes & Deep Builds

  • Start as an Adventurer and choose your path at Level 10: Swordsman, Ranger, Cleric or Assassin

  • Six allocatable stats let you craft your own build

  • A talent system that forces real specialization choices as you grow

  • Unlock skills across four rarity tiers — Normal, Rare, Epic, and Legend

Loot-Driven Progression

  • 14 equipment slots across four gear tiers, with set bonuses to chase

  • A high-stakes +1 to +10 enhancement system — push your luck or play it safe

  • Socket gems and shards into your gear to fine-tune your power

  • Grind your way to the Level 35 cap through an endgame band built for dedicated players

A World to Explore

  • Seven distinct zones, from the gentle Forest Path to the climactic Creator's Gate

  • A linear main story plus side quests in every zone

  • Waypoint fast travel and a full world map

  • A progressively-unlocked Monsterpedia bestiary that rewards you for hunting

Epic Boss Battles

  • Face The Forgotten One in a multi-phase fight with telegraphed attacks, summons, and an enrage phase

  • Take on a roaming mini-boss and a shared-world boss encounter

  • Party up and challenge Primordius in his lair

Play Your Way

  • A full auto-combat system with Hunt and Guard modes for idle-style grinding

  • Configurable auto-potion thresholds

  • Assign skill rotations and auto-heal sequences that fight for you

Play in your language

  • Full interface & content localization in English, Spanish, French, German, Portuguese, Italian, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Japanese, and Korean.

Online & Social

  • See other players in the world in real time

  • Global chat with live loot, level-up, and enhancement announcements

  • Join a Guild and conquer the world

  • A player-driven marketplace to buy and sell gear

  • Account-shared storage across all your characters

Compete & Climb

  • Hourly leaderboards across multiple categories, including an overall Combat Power ranking

  • Top three players earn bronze, silver, and gold medals

Daily Rewards & Achievements

  • Daily quests, a 7-day login reward cycle, and the Eloria's Favor blessing that triples your rewards

  • Dozens of achievements that grant EXP and cosmetic titles

Built to Last

  • Five character slots with cloud saves

  • A clean, modern glassmorphism interface

  • Ongoing updates from a developer who reads every bug report

Echoes of Creation is in active development. As a solo project, it grows with every update — and your feedback shapes where it goes next. Although in Early Access, there will be no character reset on release day, you get to keep your hard earned saves!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4460 / AMD FX-8350 (or equivalent)
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 / AMD RX 560 (2 GB VRAM, Vulkan 1.0 support required)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX Compatible
  • VR Support: None
  • Additional Notes: Vulkan-capable GPU required (Godot 4 Forward+ renderer). Internet required for cloud saves and account login.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600 (or better)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 / AMD RX 580 (4 GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX Compatible
  • VR Support: None
  • Additional Notes: 1080p / 60 FPS at high settings. SSD recommended for faster zone loading.
